work.title: A Walk in the Woods

facts.label: Planos e conselhos
facts.sub: Use going to para o plano e should para o conselho: I’m going to hike on Saturday. You should wear warm boots and start early.

facts.label: Planos
facts.sub: Para falar do plano, use am/is/are going to + verbo: I’m going to walk the forest trail. We’re going to leave at eight. Diga o dia e a hora.

facts.label: Conselho
facts.sub: Para dar um conselho, use should + verbo: You should wear warm boots. We should be back before dark. Should não leva -s nem to.

pages.title: A snowy trail · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Friday evening in a small house in Portland. Snow falls outside the window. Cleo sits on the floor with her backpack. Her friend Marco comes in with a map. Tomorrow Cleo has a plan for a hike. Marco has a few tips.
“Hi, Cleo! Are you going to hike on Saturday?” says Cleo. “Yes, I’m going to walk the forest trail with my dad.” says Marco. “It’s going to be very cold. You should wear warm boots.” says Cleo.
